\documentclass[varwidth=true,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}

\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}
  % Adapted from the TeX Live circuitikz variable-capacitor manual entries.
  \draw (0,0) to[vC,l=$C_{\mathrm{default}}$,name=default] (3,0);
  \draw (4,0) to[variable capacitor,capacitors/scale=.8,
    capacitors/width=.3,capacitors/height=.45,
    capacitors/modifier thickness=.5,l=$C_{\mathrm{compact}}$] (7,0);

  \ctikzset{bipoles/fix tunable direction=false}
  \draw (0,-2) to[vC,l=$C_{\mathrm{legacy}}$] (3,-2);
  \ctikzset{bipoles/fix tunable direction=true}
  \draw (4,-2) to[vC,capacitors/width=.15,l=$C_{\mathrm{narrow}}$] (7,-2);

  \draw[gray,dashed] (default.wiper) -- (default.tip);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
